items.text: Career counselling for IT professionals should deal with the decisions your role actually faces: hiring-slowdown or layoff anxiety, AI tools reshaping parts of your work, a service-company-to-product move, or a technical-to-management pivot.
The goal is a high-value skill portfolio built for where tech is actually heading, unlocking high income opportunities and moving you toward earlier financial freedom, not generic "learn AI" advice.
If your direction is already clear and what you need now is help executing and staying accountable to the plan, see career coaching for IT professionals instead.
